name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;> simp [substOld]
  case fvar | op | const | bvar =>
    intros x Hin
    simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans cih
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans tih
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans eih
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split <;> (intros x Hin; simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars])
    · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      · apply List.Subset.trans ih1
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
        cases Hin <;> simp_all
      · apply List.Subset.trans ih2
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
  case quant trih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans trih
      intros x Hin
      simp_all [List.append_assoc]
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans eih
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    · apply List.Subset.trans ih1
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    · apply List.Subset.trans ih2
      intros x Hin
      simp_all

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  change _ → (extractOldExprVars post).Subset (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars post)
  have appMono {a b c d : List CoreIdent}
      (h₁ : a.Subset b) (h₂ : c.Subset d) : (a ++ c).Subset (b ++ d) :=
    List.Subset.app
      (List.Subset.subset_app_of_or_2 (Or.inl h₁))
      (List.Subset.subset_app_of_or_2 (Or.inr h₂))
  intro h
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => simp [extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact appMono ih₁ ih₂
  | app _ _ hn ih₁ ih₂ =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact fun _ => id
    · next hf =>
      exfalso
      cases hn (by constructor)
      exact hf _ _ _ rfl
    · exact appMono ih₁ ih₂
  | ite _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact appMono (appMono ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  | eq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact appMono ih₁ ih₂

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  refine ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit)
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit)
  · have hlenU := UpdateStatesLength Hup
    have hcomm := updatedStatesComm (σ:=σ) (kvs:=ks'.zip vs') (kvs':=ks.zip vs) (by
      rw [List.unzip_zip, List.unzip_zip]
      · intro k hk hk'
        simpa [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k hk] using
          (UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk')
      · exact hlenU
      · exact InitStatesLength Hinit)
    have hdef : isDefined (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks :=
      updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup)
    simpa only [updatedStates, InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup, hcomm] using
      (updatedStatesUpdate hlenU hdef)

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  let q : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have hself : 0 < q x₀ := by
    obtain ⟨c, _, hc, _, hbound⟩ :=
      InnerProductSpace'.inner_top_equiv_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := V)
    have hle : c * ‖f x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ q x₀ := by
      simpa only [q, smul_eq_mul, RCLike.re_to_real] using (hbound (f x₀)).1
    exact (mul_pos hc (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx₀))).trans_le hle
  have hcont : Continuous q :=
    Continuous.inner' (f : Y → V) (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have hopen : IsOpen {x | 0 < q x} := isOpen_Ioi.preimage hcont
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen x₀ hself
  have hqpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < q x := fun x hx => hδ hx
  haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let b : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, by positivity, by linarith⟩
  let φ : Y → ℝ := b.toFun
  have hφt : IsTestFunction φ := ⟨b.contDiff, b.hasCompactSupport⟩
  let g : Y → V := fun x => φ x • f x₀
  have hgt : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφt contDiff_const
  have hzero := hg g hgt
  simp only [g, inner_smul_right'] at hzero
  have hsupp : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ := by
    rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq]
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => φ x * q x) μ :=
    (Continuous.mul hφt.smooth.continuous hcont).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      hφt.supp.mul_right
  have hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * q x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg (b.nonneg) (hqpos x (hsupp hx)).le
    · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
  have hμball : 0 < μ (Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 2)) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by linarith))
  have hsubset : Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 2) ⊆ Function.support (fun x => φ x * q x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hφx : φ x = 1 :=
      b.one_of_mem_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)
    have hqx := hqpos x (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx)
    simp only [Function.support_mul, Set.mem_inter_iff, Function.mem_support, ne_eq]
    exact ⟨by simp [hφx], hqx.ne.symm⟩
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * q x ∂μ :=
    (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg hnonneg hint).mpr
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hμball (measure_mono hsubset))
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hzero

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  calc _
    _= ∂ₜ (fun t =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (fun t => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub]
      simp only [one_div, mul_inv_rev, FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      simp [Time.deriv_eq]
      · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ((∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x)) t) -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * (∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t) := by
      congr
      rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext k
      rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
      apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      apply hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *(∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x -
        ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext k
        congr
        funext x
        rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    _ = (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x)) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by simp [mul_sub]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs _), Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        change (∑ j, Space.deriv i (fun x => Space.deriv j (fun x => (A.electricField 𝓕.c t x).ofLp j) x) x) =
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x => ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => (A.electricField 𝓕.c t x).ofLp j) x) x) (Space.basis i)
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr 2
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h

        conv_lhs =>
          enter [2, 2, x]
          rw [(h t x).1]
        trans 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * Space.deriv i
            (fun x => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
        · congr
          funext x
          ring
        · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_const_mul]
          simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          field_simp
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          exact hJ.differentiable (by simp)
        · exact hA
        · exact hJ
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
          simp [FreeSpace.c_sq]
          field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (_ : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :=
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * c * b) = ι (c * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pb]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (_ : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :=
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * c * ofCrAnListF φs) = ι (c * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      dsimp [c]
      let s := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
      let u := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        s))
      let v := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
        crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'))
      let w := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
        crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs))
      let z := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
        crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        s))
      calc _
        /- Split the commutator. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          module
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (u * v *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
              w * z -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          u * v *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
              w * z) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp, h2]
          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
          simp [s, u, v, w, z]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (u * v *
              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
                ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) * w * z) := by
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (u * v *
              ι c *
              w * z) := by
            dsimp [c]
            congr
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
            simp [← ofCrAnListF_append]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp only [s, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append,
        List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all [pa,mul_add, add_mul]
    · intro x hx hpx
      simp_all [pa]
  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all [pb,mul_add]
  · intro x hx hpx
    simp_all [pb]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have := der
  induction der <;> subst_vars
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    rcases ih_l rfl l with val_l | ⟨t₁', step_l⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with val_r | ⟨t₂', step_r⟩
      · obtain ⟨δ, body, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
        exact .inr ⟨_, .abs l.wf.2.1 val_r⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨_, .appᵣ val_l step_r⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 step_l⟩
  case tapp σ' der sub ih =>
    have hσ := sub.wf.2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', step⟩
    · obtain ⟨δ, body, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact .inr ⟨_, .tabs der.wf.2.1 hσ⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .tapp hσ step⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L d body ih _ =>
    have hbody := (body_let.mp (Typing.let' L d body).wf.2.1).2
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨t₁', step⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .let_body val hbody⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .let_bind step hbody⟩
  case inl d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨t', step⟩
    · exact .inl (.inl val)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inl step⟩
  case inr d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨t', step⟩
    · exact .inl (.inr val)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inr step⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ L d h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨b₂, b₃⟩ := (body_case.mp (Typing.case L d h₂ h₃).wf.2.1).2
    rcases ih rfl d with val | ⟨t₁', step⟩
    · rcases d.canonical_form_sum val with ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩
      · cases val with
        | inl vu => exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inl vu b₂ b₃⟩
      · cases val with
        | inr vu => exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inr vu b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .case step b₂ b₃⟩
  case sub d s ih => exact ih rfl d
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs this.wf.2.1)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs this.wf.2.1)
  simp_all

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  have join {x y} (h : ParallelReduction y x) : Join ParallelReduction x y :=
    ⟨x, .refl _, h⟩
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb ih_a ih_b =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
      rcases ih_a ha' with ⟨x, h₁, h₂⟩
      rcases ih_b hb' with ⟨y, h₃, h₄⟩
      exact ⟨_, .par h₁ h₃, .par h₂ h₄⟩
    case red_I =>
      cases ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I .., hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      rcases Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩
    case red_S x z =>
      rcases Sab_irreducible x z a' ha with ⟨x', z', hx, hz, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .red_S ..,
        .par (.par hx hb) (.par hz hb)⟩
  case red_I x =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact join (.red_I ..)
    case par c d hc hd =>
      cases hc
      exact ⟨_, hd, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact join (.refl x)
  case red_K x y =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact join (.red_K ..)
    case par d z hd hz =>
      rcases Ka_irreducible x d hd with ⟨x', hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
    case red_K => exact join (.refl x)
  case red_S x y z =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact join (.red_S ..)
    case par d z' hd hz =>
      rcases Sab_irreducible x y d hd with ⟨x', y', hx, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hz) (.par hy hz), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact join (.refl _)

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr <;> rename_i hpq <;> constructor
  · intro s1' ht
    cases ht <;> rename_i htr
    · obtain ⟨s2', ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨s2', .choiceL ht2, .bisim hb⟩
    · exact ⟨s1', .choiceR htr, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
  · intro s2' ht
    cases ht <;> rename_i htr
    · obtain ⟨s1', ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨s1', .choiceL ht1, .bisim hb⟩
    · exact ⟨s2', .choiceR htr, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
  · intro s1' ht
    obtain ⟨s2', ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
    exact ⟨s2', ht2, .bisim hb⟩
  · intro s2' ht
    obtain ⟨s1', ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd ht
    exact ⟨s1', ht1, .bisim hb⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  -- 2 * Δ₀(f, ↑(BBF_Code 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)) < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp [d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
    exact Nat.succ_pos _

  -- 1. Relate Hamming distance `d_H` to fiber-wise distance `d_fw`.
  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    -- Let `S` be the set of all possible fiber-wise disagreement sizes.
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    -- The code `C_i` (a submodule) is non-empty, so `S` is also non-empty.
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    -- For a non-empty set of natural numbers, `sInf` is an element of the set.
    have h_sInf_mem := Nat.sInf_mem hS_nonempty
    -- By definition, `d_fw = sInf S`.
    -- Since `sInf S` is in the image set `S`, there must be an element `g_subtype` in the domain
    -- (`C_i`) that maps to it. This `g_subtype` is the codeword we're looking for.
    rw [Set.mem_image] at h_sInf_mem
    rcases h_sInf_mem with ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩
    -- Extract the codeword and its membership proof.
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, h_eq.symm⟩

  -- The Hamming distance to any codeword `g'` is bounded by `d_fw * 2 ^ steps`.
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    -- This proves `dist f g' ≤ (fiberwiseDisagreementSet ... f g').ncard * 2 ^ steps`
    -- and lifts to ℕ∞. We prove the `Nat` version `hammingDist f g' ≤ ...`,
    -- which is equivalent.
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    -- Let ΔH be the finset of actually bad x points where f and g' disagree.
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    have h_dist_eq_card : hammingDist f g' = ΔH.card := by
      simp only [hammingDist, ne_eq, ΔH]
    rw [h_dist_eq_card]
    -- Y_bad is the set of quotient points y that THERE EXISTS a bad fiber point x
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    -- ⊢ #ΔH ≤ Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps

    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := by exact Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    -- Every point of disagreement `x` must belong to a fiber over some `y` in `Y_bad`,
    -- BY DEFINITION of `Y_bad`. Therefore, `ΔH` is a subset of the union of the fibers
    -- of `Y_bad`
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))).toFinset) := by
      -- ⊢ If any x ∈ ΔH, then x ∈ Union(qMap_total_fiber(y), ∀ y ∈ Y_bad)
      intro x hx_in_ΔH; -- ⊢ x ∈ Union(qMap_total_fiber(y), ∀ y ∈ Y_bad)
      simp only [ΔH, Finset.mem_filter] at hx_in_ΔH
      -- Now we actually apply iterated qMap into x to get y_of_x,
      -- then x ∈ qMap_total_fiber(y_of_x) by definition
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr; use y_of_x
      -- ⊢ y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset ∧ x ∈ qMap_total_fiber(y_of_x)
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset := by
        -- ⊢ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset
        simp only [fiberwiseDisagreementSet, iteratedQuotientMap, ne_eq, Subtype.exists,
          Set.toFinset_setOf, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Y_bad]
        -- one bad fiber point of y_of_x is x itself
        let X := x.val
        have h_X_in_source : X ∈ sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem x
        use X
        use h_X_in_source
        -- ⊢ Ŵ_steps⁽ⁱ⁾(X) = y (iterated quotient map) ∧ ¬f ⟨X, ⋯⟩ = g' ⟨X, ⋯⟩
        have h_forward_iterated_qmap : Polynomial.eval X
            (intermediateNormVpoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, by omega⟩
              ⟨steps, by simp only; omega⟩) = y_of_x := by
          simp only [iteratedQuotientMap, X, y_of_x];
        have h_eval_diff : f ⟨X, by omega⟩ ≠ g' ⟨X, by omega⟩ := by
          unfold X
          simp only [Subtype.coe_eta, ne_eq, hx_in_ΔH, not_false_eq_true]
        simp only [h_forward_iterated_qmap, Subtype.coe_eta, h_eval_diff,
          not_false_eq_true, and_self]
      simp only [h_elemenet_Y_bad, true_and]

      set qMapFiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y_of_x)
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp (by rfl)
      exact h_res
    -- ⊢ #ΔH ≤ Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    -- The cardinality of a subset is at most the cardinality of the superset.
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    -- The cardinality of a disjoint union is the sum of cardinalities.
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · -- The size of the sum is the number of bad fibers (`Y_bad.ncard`) times
      -- the size of each fiber (`2 ^ steps`).
      simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
      have h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
        (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
      simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset,
        Subtype.forall] at h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point
      have h_card_fiber_of_each_y : ∀ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset,
          Fintype.card ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
            ↑(Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))) = 2 ^ steps := by
        intro y hy_in_Y_bad
        have hy_card_fiber_of_y := h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point (a := y) (b := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem y)
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, hy_card_fiber_of_y]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_card_fiber_of_each_y]
      -- ⊢ ∑ x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, 2 ^ steps ≤ Y_bad.encard.toNat * 2 ^ steps
      simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ofNat_pos, pow_pos,
        _root_.mul_le_mul_right, ge_iff_le]
      conv_rhs => rw [←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq] -- convert .ncard back to .card
      -- ⊢ Fintype.card ↑Y_bad ≤ Nat.card ↑Y_bad
      simp only [card_eq_fintype_card, le_refl]
    · -- Prove that the fibers for distinct quotient points y₁, y₂ are disjoint.
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ hy_ne
      have h_disjoint := qMap_total_fiber_disjoint (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y₁ := y₁) (y₂ := y₂) (hy_ne := hy_ne)
      simp only [Function.onFun, coe_univ]
      exact h_disjoint

  -- The minimum distance `d_H` is bounded by the distance to this specific `g'`.
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    calc
      d_H ≤ hammingDist f g' := by
        simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H]
        exact sInf_le ⟨g', h_g'_mem, le_refl _⟩
      _ ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size

  -- 2. Use the premise : `2 * d_fw < d_{i+steps}`.
  -- As a `Nat` inequality, this is equivalent to `2 * d_fw ≤ d_{i+steps} - 1`.
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    -- Convert the ENat inequality to a Nat inequality using `a < b ↔ a + 1 ≤ b`.
    exact Nat.le_pred_of_lt (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)

  -- 3. The Algebraic Identity.
  -- The core of the proof is the identity : `(d_{i+steps} - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1`.
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    have h2 : (ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps) = ℓ - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    rw [h1, h2]

  -- 4. Conclusion : Chain the inequalities to prove `2 * d_H < d_i`.
  -- We know `d_H` is finite, since `C_i` is nonempty.
  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, d_H]
    rw [Code.distFromCode_eq_top_iff_empty f C_i]
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp ⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩

  -- We can now work with the `Nat` value of `d_H`.
  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm

  -- The calculation is now done entirely in `Nat`.
  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
      exact ENat.coe_le_coe.mp (le_of_eq_of_le h_dH_eq.symm h_dist_bridge)
    calc 2 * d_H_nat
      _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 h_bridge_nat
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := (Nat.mul_assoc 2 d_fw (2 ^ steps)).symm
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) h_fw_bound
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_algebraic_identity

  simp only [d_H, d_H_nat] at h_dH_eq
  -- This final line is equivalent to the goal statement.
  rw [h_dH_eq]
  -- ⊢ 2 * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, by omega⟩)
  rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (n := 2 * Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat) (m := d_i) (h := h_d_i_gt_0)
    (h_final_inequality)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  set P_i := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  set new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  have h_eval_qMap (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)
    have h_res := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) (by exact ⟨k, rfl⟩)
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val h_res).symm
  have h0 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y (0 : Fin 2)
  have h1 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y (1 : Fin 2)
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    simp only [x₀, x₁, fiberMap] at h0 h1 ⊢
    rw [h1, h0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  set P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  -- Equation 39 : P^(i)(X) = P₀^(i+1)(q^(i)(X)) + X · P₁^(i+1)(q^(i)(X))
  have h_equation (x : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩)
      (hx : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x.val = y) :
      P_i.eval x.val = P₀.eval y.val + x.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, hx,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  set f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) => P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  set f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by
      simp only [f_i]
      rw [h_equation x₀ (h_eval_qMap 0), h_equation x₁ (h_eval_qMap 1)]
      linear_combination (P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal) * h_fiber_diff
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      -- ⊢ eval y (C (1-r) * ∑...) + eval y (C r * ∑...) = eval y (∑...)
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      rw [←Polynomial.eval_add]
      -- ⊢ poly_left.eval y = poly_right.eval y
      congr
      simp_rw [mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      -- We now prove that the terms inside the sums are equal for each index.
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      simp only [Polynomial.C_mul, Polynomial.C_add]
      ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero =>
    intro u
    contradiction
  | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
    cases ϑ_sub_1 with
    | zero =>
      simp only [zero_add, gt_iff_lt, zero_lt_one, ModuleCode, forall_const]
      intro u
      intro hprob_gt
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)] at hprob_gt
      simp_rw [prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
        (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
      have h_correlated_agreement := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
      simp only [jointProximityNat₂, Fin.isValue] at h_correlated_agreement
      have h_u_eq: u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext rowIdx
        fin_cases rowIdx <;> rfl
      rw [h_u_eq.symm] at h_correlated_agreement
      exact h_correlated_agreement
    | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
      intro hϑ_gt_0 u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      let ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
      set U₀ : Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred) → Word A ι :=
        (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).1
      set U₁ : Fin (2 ^ ϑ_pred) → Word A ι :=
        (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).2
      unfold jointProximityNat
      simp only
      have h_finsnoc_eq_r: ∀ r: Fin (ϑ_pred + 1) → F,
        Fin.snoc (fun (i : Fin ϑ_pred) ↦ r i.castSucc)
          (r (Fin.last ϑ_pred)) = r := fun r => by
        exact Fin.snoc_init_self r
      let P : F → (Fin ϑ_pred → F) → Prop := fun r_last r_init =>
        Δ₀(multilinearCombine (u:=u) (r:=Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e
      let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (F := F) (P := P)
      unfold P at hP_split_r_last
      simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last
      rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      have multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine
        (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) (r_last : F) : multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last) =
          multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
        rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
        simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc]
        rfl
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine]
        at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m:=ϑ_pred) (e:=e) (ε:=ε) U₀ U₁
      have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ r ∈ R_star_set ]
        > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        exact prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (u := u)
          (e := e) hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      have h_line_close_to_C_m : ∀ (r : R_star_set),
        jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) :=
        correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
          (ih := fun u_prev => ih (Nat.succ_pos _) u_prev) (u := u)
      let m := 2 ^ ϑ_pred
      let W₀ : Word (Fin m → A) ι := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin m) ι from U₀)
      let W₁ : Word (Fin m → A) ι := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin m) ι from U₁)
      let C' := (MC : Set (ι → A)) ^⋈ (Fin m)
      let Q := fun r : F => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation W₀ W₁ r, C') ≤ e
      have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
        Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[Q r] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        apply lt_of_le_of_lt' _ h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
        have h_r_implies: ∀ (r : F), r ∈ R_star_set → Q r := by
          intro r hr_in_Rstar
          specialize h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr_in_Rstar⟩
          unfold jointProximityNat at h_line_close_to_C_m
          exact h_line_close_to_C_m
        exact Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F) (h_imp := h_r_implies)
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      simpa only [W₀, W₁, C', U₀, U₁] using
        (show jointProximityNat₂ (u₀ := W₀) (u₁ := W₁) (e := e) (C := C') from
          h_interleaved_gaps m (Nat.one_le_two_pow) W₀ W₁ h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q)

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hf : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have hs : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      simp only [f, Set.mem_Icc, Prod.le_def]
      exact ⟨⟨(hB n).1, (hB (n+1)).1, (hB (n+2)).1, (hB (n+3)).1⟩,
        ⟨(hB n).2, (hB (n+1)).2, (hB (n+2)).2, (hB (n+3)).2⟩⟩
    exact (Set.finite_Icc _ _).subset hs
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,hij'⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j :=
    Set.Finite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (f := f) (t := Set.range f)
      (fun n => ⟨n, rfl⟩) hf
  have heq := hij'
  have hstep : ∀ k l : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → 4 ≤ l →
      u (k-1) = u (l-1) → u (k-2) = u (l-2) → u (k-3) = u (l-3) → u (k-4) = u (l-4) → u k = u l := by
    intro k l hk hl h1 h2 h3 h4
    have hreal : (u k : ℝ) = (u l : ℝ) :=
      (hu k hk).1.trans (by rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]; exact (hu l hl).1.symm)
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  have hshift : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i+m) = u (j+m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      match m with
      | 0 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.1) heq
      | 1 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.2.1) heq
      | 2 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.2.2.1) heq
      | 3 => simpa [f] using congrArg (fun x => x.2.2.2) heq
      | m+4 =>
        have ebefore : ∀ r, 0 < r → r ≤ 4 →
            u (i+(m+4)-r) = u (j+(m+4)-r) := by
          intro r hr hr4
          have q := ih (m+(4-r)) (by omega)
          have a : i+(m+4)-r = i+(m+(4-r)) := by omega
          have b : j+(m+4)-r = j+(m+(4-r)) := by omega
          simpa only [a,b] using q
        have e1 := ebefore 1 (by omega) (by omega)
        have e2 := ebefore 2 (by omega) (by omega)
        have e3 := ebefore 3 (by omega) (by omega)
        have e4 := ebefore 4 (by omega) (by omega)
        exact hstep _ _ (by omega) (by omega) e1 e2 e3 e4
  refine ⟨i,j-i,by omega,?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have h := hshift (n-i)
  have hi : i+(n-i)=n := by omega
  have hj : j+(n-i)=n+(j-i) := by omega
  rw [hi,hj] at h
  exact h.symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hmiss : ∀ A : Set S, A ∉ P → ∃ U : Set S, U ∈ P ∧ A ∩ U = ∅ := by
    intro A hA
    by_contra hn
    exact hPS ⟨A, hA, by
      intro U hU
      by_contra hne
      exact hn ⟨U, hU, hne⟩⟩
  have hcomp : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    obtain ⟨hA, hAc⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hu⟩ := hmiss A hA
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hv⟩ := hmiss Aᶜ hAc
    have ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hPP U hU V hV)
    change x ∈ U ∧ x ∈ V at hx
    have hxna : x ∉ A := by
      intro ha
      have hmem : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨ha, hx.1⟩
      rw [hu] at hmem
      simpa using hmem
    have hxa : x ∈ A := by
      by_contra hxna'
      have hmem : x ∈ Aᶜ ∩ V := ⟨by simpa using hxna', hx.2⟩
      rw [hv] at hmem
      simpa using hmem
    exact hxna hxa
  have hnotboth : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    exact (hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc) (by ext x; simp)
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have hPQ : P.card = Q.card := by
    refine Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ) ?_ ?_ (by intro A hA; simp) (by intro A hA; simp)
    · intro A hA
      simpa [Q] using hnotboth A hA
    · intro A hA
      simp only [Q, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hA
      exact (hcomp A).resolve_left hA
  have hsum : Q.card + P.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card :=
    Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ P)
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    simp [Fintype.card_fun]
  have hdouble : P.card * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← hPQ, huniv] at hsum
    omega
  have hn : 0 < Fintype.card S :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨Classical.choice ‹Nonempty S›⟩
  have hpow : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ]
    congr 1
    omega
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  let w : Fin 9 → ℤ := fun j => (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1
  have patch (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) =
        digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * w i := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * w j) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (x j * w j + (if j = i then (y j - x j) else 0) * w j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        by_cases h : j = i
        · subst j
          simp only [w, if_true]
          ring
        · simp only [w, if_neg h, zero_mul, add_zero]
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, x j * w j) + (y i - x i) * w i := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp [w, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, i.is_lt]
  intro d e f h i
  have hd : ∀ j : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun k : Fin 9 => if k = j then e k else d k)) :=
    (hrelation d e).mp h.1 |>.2
  have he : ∀ j : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun k : Fin 9 => if k = j then f k else e k)) :=
    (hrelation e f).mp h.2 |>.2
  have ha : ∀ j : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (e j - d j) * w j + digits_to_num d := by
    intro j
    have := hd j
    rw [patch d e j] at this
    simpa [add_comm] using this
  have hb : ∀ j : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f j - e j) * w j + digits_to_num e := by
    intro j
    have := he j
    rw [patch e f j] at this
    simpa [add_comm] using this
  have hdiff : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d +
      ∑ j : Fin 9, (e j - d j) * w j := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    ring
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have hs : 7 ∣ (∑ j : Fin 9, (e j - d j) * w j) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
      have heq : (∑ j : Fin 9, ((e j - d j) * w j + digits_to_num d)) =
          (∑ j : Fin 9, (e j - d j) * w j) + 9 * digits_to_num d := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin]
      rw [← heq]
      apply Finset.dvd_sum
      intro j hj
      exact ha j
    have h7 : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := ⟨digits_to_num d, by ring⟩
    have heq : digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d =
        ((∑ j : Fin 9, (e j - d j) * w j) + 9 * digits_to_num d) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [hdiff]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact dvd_sub hs h7
  have hprod : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * w i := by
    have hh := dvd_add (dvd_sub (hb i) hsum) (ha i)
    have hn := dvd_neg.mpr hh
    convert hn using 1 <;> ring
  have hp : Nat.Prime 7 := by norm_num
  have hpow : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    intro q
    have : (7 : ℤ) ∣ 10 := Int.Prime.dvd_pow' hp q
    norm_num at this
  exact (Int.Prime.dvd_mul' hp hprod).resolve_right hpow
